ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I’m more drawn to familiar classic hits and seasonal music right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gravel & Wine; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I don’t recognize this well enough to choose it over the familiar collections here.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I’m looking for songs rather than a relaxing classical collection today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of Fleetwood Mac; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: A strong match for my classic rock listening and preference for greatest-hits collections.
ItemID: NA; Title: James Bond Themes: The Complete Collection: 1962-2015; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The retrospective collection appeals, but I would choose the classic artist compilations first.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This fits my interest in mid-sixties hits and familiar older songs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Reputation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Although I sometimes listen to newer pop, this is less aligned with my current mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Charlie Brown Christmas [2012 Remastered & Expanded Edition]; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My recent Christmas selection makes another seasonal album appealing right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Chimes Of Freedom: The Songs Of Bob Dylan; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The Dylan songwriting connection appeals alongside my Simon & Garfunkel and older folk-pop listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: 1989; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my occasional pop listening, but I’m choosing older hits and Christmas music this time.
